description: Register sessions (shifts) opened and closed in a date range — the list behind Reports → End of Session. Answers 'what shifts ran yesterday', 'who closed the register last night', 'is a session still open'. Returns who opened and closed each one, the opening float and the declared closing amounts. A session with no closeTime is still open. For the full money report of one shift, pass its id to get_session_report.

endDate.description: End of the window, ISO 8601. Inclusive of the day when a bare date is given

outlets.description: Outlet ids to restrict to. Omit for all outlets

stations.description: Station ids to restrict to. Omit for all stations

name: hub_get_sessions
title: Register sessions
